notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Werefox Bodyguard.
description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Abdel Adrian to return to the battlefield from exile and triggering Abdel Adrian and Werefox Bodyguard.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Abdel Adrian until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
